newsitem.title: UK: SBC Warburg, Goldman top Reuter Europe survey.
newsitem.headline: SBC Warburg, Goldman top Reuter Europe survey.

text.p: SBC Warburg Securities and Goldman Sachs International retained their top spots in the 1997 Reuters survey of continental European larger company investment research on Tuesday.
Fund management groups voted SBC Warburg as offering the best research, with 10.29 percent of the vote against 11.92 percent last year. The survey was conducted by Tempest Consultants Ltd.
Company finance directors voted Goldman Sachs best for broker research, with 9.87 percent of the vote, up from 8.15 percent last time.
In other awards, Fidelity Investments was voted best fund management group according to finance directors, and Fidelity was also voted best individual fund manager.
Fund managers chose the banks team at SBC Warburg as best broker research team and rated Morgan Stanley the best broker sales team.
